highlights:
Japan takes on Sweden at AT&T Stadium in Texas on 25 June for a World Cup Group F clash. Over the years, Japan has built a reputation as a sharp, fearless side that loves upsetting big names, while Sweden brings that classic European grit and a long history of deep tournament runs. Expect this one to be tight. In this Japan vs Sweden preview, we’ll break down team news and key players, to provide readers with our top betting tips for this exciting fixture.

You’ve got Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) bringing that direct pace out wide, Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) pulling strings in midfield, and Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) always a threat cutting in. Ayase Ueda (Feyenoord) is likely to lead the line, and he’s been reliable in front of goal.
